qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global scale in commercial and retail insurance, but capital efficiency is structurally impaired by catastrophe volatility at AXA XL and low-margin legacy life books. 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 9.03% and tangible ROIC of ~12% both fail the Gate 3b hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Pricing Power & Proof of Moat, REJECT). Global multi-line insurer fails the capital efficiency hurdle with a 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 9.03% and tangible ROIC peaking at 12.5%, failing both the 12% GAAP and 15% tangible ROIC thresholds. AXA XL catastrophe exposure and competitive commercial casualty lines dilute returns on capital.
qualitative.evidence: FY2022-FY2025 GAAP ROIC ranged between 7.01% and 9.11% (median 9.03%), while tangible ROIC remained compressed between 9.67% and 12.50%. LT debt of €60.5B and catastrophe volatility at AXA XL impede superior economic return generation.
